system.description: Each time you take this feat, pick one tradition you do not already have. Hidden Flame: Illusion spells Daze every enemy within 5m of the affected area for one round; Iron Sigil: Abjuration spells may grant you Aura (which reduces only damage from magical sources) of 5 plus your Abjuration rank until your next turn begins; Golden Wyvern: after a Divination spell, your next initiative roll gains your Divination ranks. Emerald Frost: choose one foe struck by an Evocation attack; its Aura counts as twice your Evocation rank lower for that damage; Serpent Eye: an Enchantment spell gives its target a check on their next save against your spells, affected or not. Stormwalker: Evocation spells deal extra damage equal to your level to all targets hit; Death's Shadow: Necromancy spells strip 1 Resilience for one round from every enemy below half HP within 10m.
